notes.summary: Placeholder vocabulary for Finance Pillar v0.1. Instrument, source, and rail tags are illustrative. Real deployments must substitute jurisdiction-specific terms and provider references (banks, payment rails, grant bodies) before any canon_root is anchored for public use. Nothing here constitutes a financial rule, rate, eligibility criterion, or binding obligation.

attestation_types.grant_award: records award of a cultural-study grant or stipend
attestation_types.tuition_payment: records a tuition or program payment
attestation_types.banking_access: confirms a resident holds a usable banking rail
attestation_types.escrow_release: records release of funds from escrow on condition
attestation_types.reimbursement: records reimbursement of an approved expense
